name: chatgpt-pdf-review
description: Ask signed-in ChatGPT through the WebContentAgent local Chrome companion, with optional PDF attachments.

interface.shortDescription: Ask signed-in ChatGPT through a local agent.
interface.longDescription: Uses WebContentAgent and its Chrome Companion to reuse a tracked ChatGPT session, send one deduplicated question with an optional allowed local PDF through the user's normal signed-in page, preserve the current thinking mode by default, return the complete response and canonical URL, and automatically recover an unverified existing response once without sending again.
defaultPrompt: Ask ChatGPT for a second opinion and bring the answer back.
Send this PDF to ChatGPT for a critical review.
Send this PDF to ChatGPT, wait for the review, and bring the response back.
